packageRules.description: Astro core and its integrations move together, so update them in one PR
Tailwind and its Vite plugin are version-locked to each other
Group GitHub Actions bumps into a single PR
Auto-merge low-risk devDependency patches once CI passes

Mirror the peerDependencies range declared by @astrojs/check ('^5.0.0 || ^6.0.0'). TypeScript 7 dropped the programmatic compiler API that astro check needs, and neither Bun nor Renovate enforces peer ranges, so without this Renovate would keep proposing TS 7 and breaking `bun run check`. Widen this when @astrojs/check widens its peer range (expected once TS 7.1 restores the API).
